title: Palace of King Bell
scope: The Palace of King Bell, also called La Pagode, including the raised arched veranda, central second-floor porch, upper pavilion and cupola.
limitations: Paint colors and less visible rear elevations are generalized from available evidence. Small fretwork and columns reproduce the visible pattern at a practical model scale.
The coarse elevation data include surface returns and do not survey the individual stair treads or wall footings.
